## Invitations

During the reporting period, 1898 invitations were issued to prospective participants. A total of 845 people attended, representing an attendance rate of 44.5 per cent. The figures provide a straightforward summary of invitation activity and participation during the quarter. They should be read as a record of contacts made and attendance received, rather than as an assessment of individual circumstances.

Attendance tends to dip in winter and recover in spring. This seasonal pattern may be relevant when planning future outreach activity and reviewing participation levels. Continued monitoring will help identify whether the pattern remains consistent across reporting periods.

## Contact

SMS contact reached 0 invitees. No reminders were issued, with reminders recorded as 0. These figures indicate that neither SMS messages nor reminder communications contributed to the reported attendance during this period. Future outreach reviews may consider whether additional contact methods would support participation, subject to local arrangements and available resources.
